title: Adversarially Robust PAC Learning with Optimal VC Rates
abstract: arXiv:2609.24260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the problem of \emph{adversarially robust} PAC learning. In this framework, the learner observes independent samples from an unknown distribution over $\mathcal{X} \times \{0,1\}$, as in classical PAC learning. However, given a perturbation map $\mathcal{U} : \mathcal{X} \to 2^{\mathcal{X}}$ known to the learner, the goal is to output, with high probability, a predictor that correctly classifies \emph{every} perturbation $z \in \mathcal{U}(x)$ of most future examples $(x,y)$ drawn from the same underlying distribution. translated_title: 具有最优VC速率的对抗鲁棒PAC学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究对抗鲁棒PAC学习问题。在该框架中，学习器如同经典PAC学习一样，观测来自未知分布 $\mathcal{X} \times \{0,1\}$ 上的独立样本。然而，在给定一个学习器已知的扰动映射 $\mathcal{U}: \mathcal{X} \to 2^{\mathcal{X}}$ 的情况下，目标是以高概率输出一个预测器，使其能够对来自同一底层分布的大多数未来样本 $(x,y)$ 的每一个扰动 $z \in \mathcal{U}(x)$ 都进行正确分类。我们确定了该问题在可实现和不可知两种设置下的最优的与 $\mathcal{U}$ 无关的样本复杂度。更具体地说，对于每个VC维数为 $d$ 的概念类 $\mathcal{H}$，我们证明了可实现设置下的上界为 $\mathcal{O}(d/\epsilon + \log(1/\delta)/\epsilon)$，不可知设置下的上界为 $\mathcal{O}(d/\epsilon^2 + \log(1/\delta)/\epsilon^2)$（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文确定了对抗鲁棒PAC学习在可实现与不可知两种设置下的最优样本复杂度，对VC维为 $d$ 的任意概念类分别给出了 $\mathcal{O}(d/\epsilon + \log(1/\delta)/\epsilon)$ 和 $\mathcal{O}(d/\epsilon^2 + \log(1/\delta)/\epsilon^2)$ 的紧致上界。
en_tdlr: This paper settles the optimal U-independent sample complexity of adversarially robust PAC learning in both realizable and agnostic settings, proving tight upper bounds of O(d/ε + log(1/δ)/ε) and O(d/ε² + log(1/δ)/ε²) for any concept class of VC dimension d.
